size.$description: Text sizes at the default text-size setting, px at the 1920x1080 reference.

theme-default.$description: Godot's Theme.default_font_size: the size of text whose type sets none of its own (a bare Label, a ProgressBar's percentage). 27, the greybox's 16 x 5/3, kept so bare text does not change (prime-game-ui#52).

keycap.$description: A keycap's minimum width: at least its height (2 + the body-bold line, 22 x 1.25, + 5 = 34.5), so a single-letter keycap is never narrower than it is tall.
